rules: Military material loss/damage cost, munitions expenditure, repair/reconstitution, and wider economic effects are separate.
Do not sum overlapping aggregate and item-level estimates.
UNPRICED means the evidence set lacks a defensible price basis; it does not mean zero.

estimates.scope: Incremental U.S. Department of Defense cost attributable to war, through the earlier campaign/ceasefire period
estimates.price_basis: CSIS analytical estimate using incremental budget-cost methodology
estimates.warning: Predates renewed July fighting; do not present as Aug. 20 cumulative cost.

estimates.scope: Pentagon war-cost figure reported by Reuters
estimates.warning: Reuters reported that the figure included current and projected costs through Sept. 30. Do not label it clean actual-to-date spending.
